description:
Add tests and checks that prove scenario extraction preserves existing fixture compatibility. This task should protect fixture names, fixture paths, replay behavior, and model_compat result parsing while avoiding live API calls.

Guardrails to consider:
- unit tests mapping each scenario id to the exact existing fixture names
- replay tests against a small representative fixture set
- assertions that missing fixtures still fail with actionable messages
- documentation in test helpers that scenario extraction must not change prompts/options without an explicit fixture-refresh task

Optional follow-up design note: plan a backward-compatible execution metadata block for future fixtures, but do not require re-recording existing fixtures in this task.

Proof target: replay-only tests; no REQ_LLM_FIXTURES_MODE=record needed.
title: Add replay fixture guardrails for scenario extraction
